card.name: Small words after a place or noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, the, in or de that follow a noun naming a place, building or office, mostly in biblical, historical or encyclopedic prose. They introduce the owner or the location.

modes.description: The word of or the follows a place or object noun and introduces its owner or contents.

modes.description: A linking or name word sits inside a proper name or title.

modes.label: Preposition after verb phrase
modes.description: In narrative text, in follows a verb of placing or pitching, ahead of a location.
